items.title: iPhone despenca de 30 km de altura e continua funcionando; assista ao vídeo
items.pt:
Um iPhone 17 Pro despencou de uma altura superior a 30 km e continuou funcionando após atingir o solo. O teste foi realizado no dia 24 de junho pela fabricante de acessórios RhinoShield em parceria com a empresa aeroespacial britânica Sent Into Space, e o experimento entrou para o Guinness World Records.

items.title: Melhor que jogar no PC? Novo POCO F9 Ultra promete rodar jogos em 185 FPS
items.pt:
A POCO anunciou nesta terça-feira (1º) a nova linha POCO F9, formada pelos modelos F9 Ultra e F9 Pro. O destaque fica para o modelo mais avançado, que combina hardware de alto desempenho com um chip dedicado para processamento gráfico e promete alcançar até 185 FPS em jogos compatíveis.
A fabricante também traz tela AMOLED de alta frequência, bateria de grande capacidade e áudio desenvolvido em parceria com a Bose.

items.title: You're not done when it works. You're done when they can change it.
items.pt:
The deployment I think about most didn't fail. It passed UAT, it went live, the customer was pleased, and there was a genuinely nice email at the end of it.

Six months later it was still running and nobody had touched it. Not once. The prompt was byte-identical to the one I'd left. A model version had been deprecated underneath it and the team had pinned the old one rather than test the new. Someone had asked for a small change to the output format and been told it wasn't worth the risk.

items.title: Your unanswered comments are worth more than your next post, and nothing shows you which they are
items.pt:
Every platform I write on is good at telling me about other people's posts and bad at telling me which of my own threads has an open question sitting in it. The highest-value action on the board is also the one that is structurally hardest to see, and I think that explains a lot of quiet accounts better than laziness does.


  
  
  What I found this morning


I went through four of my own threads. Three had substantive comments nobody had answered.

One was a week old, twelve hundred characters

items.title: How to Build a Startup Advisory Board That Works
items.pt:
A founder I know spent four months assembling what he called a "killer advisory board." Six names, two of them recognisable. He put their headshots on the website and gave away 4.5% of his company.

Eighteen months later he'd had three conversations with any of them. One never replied after the paperwork was signed. The equity kept vesting anyway, because nobody had written down what the advisors were supposed to do or what happened if they didn't do it.

That's the default outcome. A startup ad

items.title: Configurable Semantic Chunking for Biomedical Information Extraction in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.pt: BioMedRAG introduced retrieval-augmented generation with a learned chunk scorer for biomedical information extraction. items.title: DIASENTINEL: An Auditable Multi-Agent System for Guideline-Grounded Diabetes Risk Screening
items.pt: Large language models (LLMs) offer promising clinical decision support but remain vulnerable to hallucinated facts, unsupported recommendations, and citation errors. We present DIASENTINEL, a fully on-premise multi-agent system for one-year type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) risk screening and guideline-grounded report generation from electronic health records (EHRs). The system integrates calibrated risk prediction, deterministic clinical signal extraction, Reciprocal Rank Fusion over American Dia
